facts.value: Supports later aerial-jump eligibility by classifying the current motion ID against two configured ranges. The caller blocks its jump entry while this predicate is true and cmd_vars[0] is zero; jump-capacity and controller-input guards also apply. The predicate itself does not measure elapsed time or animation frames.
facts.rationale: Correct animation-interval wording: ranges contain motion IDs, not frame indices. Current caller independently confirms the command-variable bypass without relying on historical wiki delay statements.

evidence.why: Two sentinel-guarded half-open motion-ID range tests.
Membership and command variable gate later-jump branch alongside capacity and input.
